entries.detail: Both shell MCPs did not go unresponsive during this session. The written record (GOAL_LOOP_INTERSTICE_HANGS_AND_AKIN_SOCIAL_2026-08-19_NOTES.md) shows: tools were verified before use (item 0.3), load management was actively monitored with a load gate that confirmed the machine could handle builds (item 0.9), and all heavy operations (swift test with 1438 tests, load gate checks, tool verification scripts) completed successfully with no evidence of shell channel failures, MCP unresponsiveness, or need for Terminal.app fallback recovery. entries.rule_title: Both shell MCPs going dead at once means load starvation, not a crash

entries.detail: A foreground `swift test` command ran for 120.649 seconds (line 316) with no interim report or progress update documented in the session record.
